name: erf_7_8_3
doc: Two-sided bound on `𝖬(x)` for `x ≥ 0` (DLMF 7.8.3): `√π/(2√π·x + 2) ≤ 𝖬(x) ≤ 1/(x+1)`. (Lower bound corrected 2026-06-25
concl: Real.sqrt Real.pi / (2 * Real.sqrt Real.pi * x + 2) ≤ (Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2) * Real.exp (x ^ 2) * FLMF.Error.erfc x ∧ (Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2) * Real.exp (x ^ 2) * FLMF.Error.erfc x < 1 / (x + 1)
